segments.contextAfter: `animatingDifferences`: If [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true), the diffable data source computes the difference between the collection view’s current state and the new state in the snapshot, which is an O(*n*) operation, where *n* is the number of items in the snapshot. The differences in the UI between the current state and new state are animated. If [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false), the collection view UI is set to the new state without any animations, with no additional overhead for computing a diff. Any ongoing item animations are interrupted and the collection view’s content is reloaded immediately.
